title: permission/request & permission/timeout
description: Request `permission/request` (daemon -> client): passthrough of an ACP `session/request_permission` emitted by the agent. The client answers allow/deny by selecting one of the offered options. If no client is connected to the session, the daemon denies by default. If the client does not answer within the configured timeout, the daemon denies and emits the `permission/timeout` notification.

permissionOptionKind.description: Hint about the nature of a permission option (mirrors ACP).

name.description: Human-readable label to display to the user.

sessionId.description: The Meltemi session this request belongs to.

toolCall.description: ACP ToolCallUpdate describing the tool or operation to authorize: title, kind, affected command or path (rawInput/locations), and external-effect classification when the agent provides it. Shape owned by the ACP contract (forwarded verbatim).

timeoutParams.description: Notification `permission/timeout` (daemon -> client): a permission request expired without an answer and was denied.

rule.description: A persistent permission rule, evaluated in the daemon before a request is escalated. Matchers are ANDed; an omitted matcher matches anything on that dimension. A rule never grants an option the agent did not offer.

effect.description: Whether the rule allows or denies the matched request.

commandPrefix.description: Match when the request's command starts with this prefix.

pathPrefix.description: Match when the affected path starts with this prefix.

scope.description: Where the rule lives: the user's global file or the project's .meltemi/permissions.toml.

pendingPermission.description: One pending permission request as seen in a queue snapshot.

requestId.description: Stable id of this pending request, used by permission/decide.

tool.description: Short tool/operation label from the ACP tool call.

summary.description: One-line human summary of what is being authorized.

waitingSeconds.description: Seconds the request has been waiting (snapshot at query time).

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until it expires; negative once expired (snapshot). Absent when the wait policy imposes no deadline (waiting for the human).

expired.description: Whether it has already expired but is still shown (never dropped silently).

suggestedRule.description: A rule suggested to end repeated identical approvals (anti-fatigue).

pendingResult.description: Result of `permission/pending`: the current queue snapshot.

changedParams.description: Notification `permission/changed` (daemon -> client): the full current queue after a change, so every client reconciles to one snapshot without a round-trip.

decideParams.description: Params of `permission/decide` (client -> daemon): resolve a pending request by id. The first resolution wins; a later one gets `already_resolved`.

optionId.description: The chosen option id; absent cancels (denies) the request.

persistRule.description: A rule to persist alongside this decision (allow/deny always).

status.description: applied: this call resolved the request; already_resolved: another path resolved it first, nothing changed.
